# Goodfire census reference

Unmodified reference from `goodfire-ai/neuron-communities`, commit
`f0fc9db972992ac00598812f998c5ce26ff9f4db`, path `neuron_communities/graph/census.py`.
Git blob SHA: `c2d54587fb13ed1661b54638f7318280c4840ee3`.

EXP5 adapts its Curveball algorithm and stabilized excess formula to sparse observed pairs,
architecture-derived widths, explicit state, and project persistence. The reference is not
imported by the runtime. Its MIT notice is retained here; tests check shuffle equivalence.
